'''Cruisers''' were [[Water/Legends|aquatic]] siege weapons armed with one [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] used by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. '''Heavy Cruisers''' were upgraded versions with heavier [[Armor/Legends|armor]] and two laser cannons. Shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], the resistance fighter [[Shoran]] ordered four Heavy Cruisers belonging to his [[Shoran's Defenders|personal army]] in [[Tunnatutikan]] to go up a [[river]] on a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] mission. He lost contact with them after they were captured by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]]. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] members [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] ventured to Kashyyyk to assist in its [[Liberation of Kashyyyk/Legends|liberation]] and joined with Shoran to destroy three [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Jammer/Legends|jammers]].

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}
During the battle to destroy the jammers, Chewbacca's [[Army/Legends|army]] freed the four cruisers and used them to bombard a jammer on a small island.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Wookiee Cruisers and Heavy Cruisers were first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] for the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. Four of them appeared in a Chewbacca campaign mission. An optional mission objective is to free them and use them against the Imperial jammer. The mission and thus the ships appeared in the game's [[2002]] expansion pack, ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns]]''.
